```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- read_parquet("data/history.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  inner_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    probability_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date),
    time_bucket = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
      days_to_resolution > 0 ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    time_bucket = factor(
      time_bucket,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(probability_error),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  accuracy |>
    mutate(
      mean_error = scales::number(mean_error, accuracy = 0.001),
      snapshots = scales::comma(snapshots)
    ),
  col.names = c("Time to resolution", "Mean absolute error", "Snapshots"),
  caption = "Forecast accuracy by time horizon"
)

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Time until resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(probability_bin = cut(probability, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    predicted_probability = mean(probability),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  calibration |>
    mutate(
      predicted_probability = scales::percent(predicted_probability, accuracy = 0.1),
      actual_rate = scales::percent(actual_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
      n = scales::comma(n)
    ),
  col.names = c("Probability bin", "Mean predicted probability", "Actual YES rate", "Markets"),
  caption = "Final-day forecast calibration by probability bin"
)

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate, size = n)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts track outcomes most closely at the extremes",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual resolution rate",
    size = "Markets"
  )
```
